title: Nebraska month-end run event
description: One event of the month-end stream. The same stream drives the month-end UI, the ledger and the video. Delivered over Server-Sent Events as `event: month-end` with the JSON below in `data:`; `id:` is `seq`.

seq.description: Strictly increasing, gap-free within a run.

invariant.description: Present on gate events only: exactly one event per invariant.

title.description: One human-readable line. The last event of a run is a system event titled 'Month-end run complete' or 'Month-end run failed'.

detail.description: Step-specific facts. No emails, secrets or repository names.
